item.title: MAC Minute — 2026-10-02
item.description:
Rise and shine, MAC Fellas, it is Saturday, October third, and the widebody market is not sleeping. Indeed not, starting with Ethiopian Airlines doubling down on capacity with a fresh order for ten Boeing 777Fs. Ten more big freighters entering the pipeline is a major long-term fleet commitment to watch. Meanwhile, closer to home region-wise, Flydubai Cargo just launched its scheduled freighter network using Boeing 737-800s to capture e-commerce demand. And on the digital side, WiseTech is pushing direct air cargo bookings inside CargoWise, challenging independent booking platforms. A busy week for software and capacity alike. Have a great Saturday!
